predecessors.name: Tang dynasty
predecessors.text: the Huainan command of Yang Xingmi, Prince of Wu from 902: central and southern Anhui, Jiangsu and much of Jiangxi

successors.name: Southern Tang
successors.text: the whole Wu realm: Xu Zhigao (Li Bian) overthrew Yang Pu in 937 and founded the Southern Tang on it

ledger.x: 907: with the Tang gone, Yang Wo holds Huainan without recognising the Later Liang.
937: the Wu ends when Yang Pu hands the seal to Xu Zhigao.

wars.name: Wu-Wuyue border wars
wars.outcome: Intermittent fighting over border cities: Huainan forces attacked Hangzhou in 901-902 and withdrew; in 919 Qian Chuanguan won at Langshan but lost at Wuxi.

certainty.note: The Wu realm is known by its circuits and prefectures; the Huai frontier with the Later Liang and the Yangtze-Min-Chu hill frontiers are approximate, and no treaty line is recorded.
